title: System unusable when application dashboard has lots of shorcuts to load
line: Application Dashboard no longer freezes Plasma for many seconds after opening when thousands of apps or shortcuts are installed.
explanation: One second after the dashboard opens it preloads the All Applications view, which is a column of per-letter grids inside one scroll view. Each grid was sized to the full height of its items, so Qt's GridView treated every item as visible and created a delegate (icon, label, tooltip) for all of them at once: with 3000 shortcuts that blocked plasmashell for over 10 seconds and added about 770 MB. Each grid is now only as tall as the visible part of the dashboard and moves and scrolls its own view along with the outer scroll view, so only on-screen items (plus the usual cache) are created; the section keeps its full height for layout and its inner scrollbar is hidden.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: only create visible items in the Dashboard's app grids

Each section grid was as tall as all of its items, so it created a
delegate for every app at once and thousands of apps froze plasmashell.
The grid now covers only the visible part and scrolls its view along.

BUG: 494691

patches.diff:
From 7db091639c581fd6010d40ae1f30d6f442b93f63 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:09:30 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kicker: only create visible items in the Dashboard's
 app grids

Each section grid was as tall as all of its items, so it created a
delegate for every app at once and thousands of apps froze plasmashell.
The grid now covers only the visible part and scrolls its view along.

BUG: 494691
---
 applets/kicker/ItemGridView.qml      |  2 ++
 applets/kicker/ItemMultiGridView.qml | 29 +++++++++++++++++++++++++---
 2 files changed, 28 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/kicker/ItemGridView.qml b/applets/kicker/ItemGridView.qml
index 4db87e24c9..53c8d47fca 100644
--- a/applets/kicker/ItemGridView.qml
+++ b/applets/kicker/ItemGridView.qml
@@ -24,6 +24,7 @@ FocusScope {
 
     property alias dropEnabled: dropAreaLoader.active
     property bool hoverEnabled: true
+    property int verticalScrollBarPolicy: PlasmaComponents.ScrollBar.AsNeeded
     property GridView view: gridView
 
     property alias currentIndex: gridView.currentIndex
@@ -180,6 +181,7 @@ FocusScope {
         focus: true
 
         PlasmaComponents.ScrollBar.horizontal.policy: PlasmaComponents.ScrollBar.AlwaysOff
+        PlasmaComponents.ScrollBar.vertical.policy: itemGrid.verticalScrollBarPolicy
 
         GridView {
             id: gridView
diff --git a/applets/kicker/ItemMultiGridView.qml b/applets/kicker/ItemMultiGridView.qml
index 69a61a6c47..8ca6875f1b 100644
--- a/applets/kicker/ItemMultiGridView.qml
+++ b/applets/kicker/ItemMultiGridView.qml
@@ -113,7 +113,7 @@ PlasmaComponents.ScrollView {
                     required property int index
 
                     width: itemColumn.width - Kirigami.Units.gridUnit
-                    height: headerHeight + gridView.height + (index == repeater.count - 1 ? 0 : footerHeight)
+                    height: headerHeight + gridView.fullHeight + (index == repeater.count - 1 ? 0 : footerHeight)
 
                     readonly property int headerHeight: (gridViewLabel.height
                         + gridViewLabelUnderline.height + Kirigami.Units.gridUnit)
@@ -161,13 +161,36 @@ PlasmaComponents.ScrollView {
                     ItemGridView {
                         id: gridView
 
+                        readonly property int fullHeight: Math.ceil(count / Math.floor(width / itemMultiGrid.cellSize)) * itemMultiGrid.cellSize
+                        // Only cover the visible part of the grid and scroll its view along, so that
+                        // delegates are not created at once for every item of a long list.
+                        readonly property real visibleTop: Math.max(0, Math.min(flickable.contentY - gridDelegate.y - gridDelegate.headerHeight, fullHeight - height))
+
+                        function syncContentY() {
+                            if (view.contentY !== visibleTop) {
+                                view.contentY = visibleTop;
+                            }
+                        }
+
                         anchors {
                             top: gridViewLabelUnderline.bottom
-                            topMargin: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit
+                            topMargin: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit + visibleTop
                         }
 
                         width: parent.width
-                        height: Math.ceil(count / Math.floor(width / itemMultiGrid.cellSize)) * itemMultiGrid.cellSize
+                        height: Math.min(fullHeight, flickable.height)
+
+                        verticalScrollBarPolicy: PlasmaComponents.ScrollBar.AlwaysOff
+                        view.interactive: false
+                        onVisibleTopChanged: syncContentY()
+
+                        Connections {
+                            target: gridView.view
+
+                            function onContentYChanged() {
+                                gridView.syncContentY();
+                            }
+                        }
 
                         cellWidth: itemMultiGrid.cellSize
                         cellHeight: itemMultiGrid.cellSize
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master with 3000 extra shortcuts: dashboard opened after a plasmashell restart; the click on All Applications 2.5 s later is lost and the dashboard stays frozen (no hover, no scrolling)
Same steps with the fix: All Applications opens right away and scrolls
Master: plasmashell at 100% CPU for about 12 s after opening, memory 400 MB to 1.18 GB
With the fix: a short blip, memory stays around 430 MB

review.text: Properly fixes the Application Dashboard freeze and memory explosion with thousands of shortcuts by virtualizing the nested per-section ItemGridViews in ItemMultiGridView.qml instead of sizing each grid to its full item height. Sizing each grid to the outer viewport height while syncing topMargin and view.contentY with visibleTop eliminates eager delegate creation while preserving layout height, wheel forwarding, and keyboard navigation. The CPU/memory plots and video clearly confirm the fix without visual or scrolling regressions.
